rows.commentary: 17.6: Eshan Malinga angles it in sharply, forcing Hasan Nawaz to dead-bat it away on the off side.
18.1: Sahan Arachchige flights it onto the stumps, meeting Arafat Minhas's forward prod into the turf.
18.2: Sahan Arachchige drops one full on middle and leg, allowing Arafat Minhas to milk a single out toward long-on.
18.3: Sahan Arachchige fires a flatter delivery near off, checked securely by Hasan Nawaz from a low base.
18.4: Sahan Arachchige serves up a tempting length, and Hasan Nawaz dances down to deposit it imperiously into the sightscreen for six.
18.5: Sahan Arachchige fires it flat and away from the batter, drawing a back-foot steer from Hasan Nawaz straight into the hands of short third.
18.6: Sahan Arachchige offers width on a short length, hammered firmly by Hasan Nawaz to sweeper cover for one.
19.1: Dilshan Madushanka hunts for the yorker right away, squeezed away by Hasan Nawaz off the outer half toward cover-point.
19.2: Dilshan Madushanka jams it in at the stumps again, safely bunted toward mid-wicket by Arafat Minhas.
19.3: Dilshan Madushanka clocks 132.6kph into the ribs, forcing a cramped Arafat Minhas to pull it down to deep square leg.
19.4: Dilshan Madushanka tests a tighter channel outside off, steered smoothly to backward point by a upright Hasan Nawaz.
19.5: Dilshan Madushanka drifts onto the pads, comfortably tucked into the short mid-wicket region with gentle hands by Hasan Nawaz.
19.6: Dilshan Madushanka targets the stumps with a full delivery, inducing an inside edge from Hasan Nawaz that scuttles away to deep backward square leg for a single.
20.1: Dunith Wellalage floats it near the off stump, and Hasan Nawaz cracks a drive toward deep cover, briskly restricted to a single by the scrambling fielder.
20.2: Dunith Wellalage pulls his length back slightly, prompting Arafat Minhas to step forward and dead-bat it firmly toward the cover region.
20.3: Dunith Wellalage grips one from a length at 77.4kph, allowing Arafat Minhas to maneuver it away for a comfortable single.
20.4: A single to Hasan Nawaz off Dunith Wellalage.
10.3: Arafat Minhas darts this arm-ball in, and Pavan Rathnayake nudges the length delivery down to long-on for a brisk single.
10.4: Arafat Minhas fires it flatter, Kamindu Mendis drops back to punch it left of the bowler, but the mid-wicket fielder pounces quickly to cut it off.
10.5: Arafat Minhas tosses this up on the stumps, Kamindu Mendis shifts across to work it toward long-on and ambles through for an easy run.
10.6: Arafat Minhas slants this into the pads, allowing Pavan Rathnayake to deflect it neatly toward backward square leg for another rotation.
11.1: Shaheen Afridi digs in a short delivery angling across, and Pavan Rathnayake stands tall to time it cleanly square of the wicket for a single.
11.2: Shaheen Afridi extracts a leading edge as Kamindu Mendis attempts an on-side flick, trickling harmlessly into the off side.
11.3: Shaheen Afridi tries the slower bumper, but it sprays well down the leg side for an immediate wide called by the umpire.
11.3: Shaheen Afridi spears a fullish delivery tailing in off the pitch, but Kamindu Mendis drills his drive straight to the fielder stationed at cover.
11.4: Shaheen Afridi traps Kamindu Mendis lbw with a full ball swinging into the pads, though DRS rightly rescues the batter as replays confirm it was missing leg.

11.5: Shaheen Afridi forces the pull with a sharp bouncer, and Kamindu Mendis hooks it to deep backward square leg where the fielder takes the catch but steps onto the cushions, awarding a maximum and a dramatic fifty.
11.6: Shaheen Afridi delivers a fullish length, and Kamindu Mendis gets behind it solidly to keep it out safely.
12.1: Arafat Minhas drops this length ball onto the stumps, and Pavan Rathnayake sweeps it firmly toward deep mid-wicket for one.
12.2: Arafat Minhas loops it up to Kamindu Mendis, who works the ball away to long-on and scampers across for a comfortable single.
12.3: Arafat Minhas fires a flat delivery as Pavan Rathnayake creates space by making room, tapping the ball cleanly toward the cover fielder.
12.4: Arafat Minhas delivers it outside off to Pavan Rathnayake, who artfully opens the bat face and steers a sharp single down toward backward point.
12.5: Arafat Minhas serves up a testing length ball, and Kamindu Mendis shuffles across his crease to dead-bat the delivery firmly into the off side.
12.6: Arafat Minhas tosses one right up to Kamindu Mendis, who simply eases the flighted ball straight back into the hands of the bowler.
13.1: Shaheen Afridi charges in with a length delivery angling across Pavan Rathnayake, who opens the face to slide it square of the wicket for a run.
13.2: No run for Kamindu Mendis off Shaheen Afridi.
